# Prophet

> Offline JSON CLI for traditional divination, astrology, and source retrieval. Explicit rules, warnings, and time uncertainty; fictional examples only.

Prophet is for cultural research and reproducible algorithm comparisons. Runtime is
offline after dependency setup. Calculations and historical texts do not establish
predictive validity. Preserve privacy and third-party licences.

## Start here

- [English overview](README.en.md): Installation, engines, and examples.
- [AI client guide](docs/for-ai.md): Tool manifest, MCP configuration, schemas, and workflow.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Setup, tests, contribution rules, and invariants.
- [Output schemas](schemas/): Generated JSON Schema contracts per CLI command.
- [Shared design](docs/SPEC.md): Layering, contracts, uncertainty, and validation.
- [Inputs and persistence](docs/core.md): Precision, solar time, cache and draw policies.

## Engines

- [Bazi](docs/bazi.md): Pillars, periods, and daily queries.
- [Ziwei](docs/ziwei.md): Charts, comparisons, and horoscopes.
- [Liuyao](docs/liuyao.md): Manual, time, and coin methods.
- [Meihua](docs/meihua.md): Time, numbers, and random methods.
- [Qimen](docs/qimen.md): Declared chart methods and rules.
- [Huangli](docs/huangli.md): Day and hour calendar fields.
- [Western astrology](docs/western.md): Natal and related calculations.
- [Tarot](docs/tarot.md): RWS card lookup and reusable draws.
- [Vedic astrology](docs/vedic.md): Lahiri charts, periods, and strength.
